gloss: Build one DOM element from a tag name, attributes and child nodes.
test: Creates a single element in code from a spec of tag, attributes and children, without writing HTML text.
not: mount-component: that attaches a whole component to a root; dom-element-build makes one element and returns it.

gloss: Attach a component to its root element, write its markup, and wire its first bindings.
test: Takes a root element and sets up the whole component inside it, including its initial state and event bindings.
not: draw-panel-section: that draws one section of a component already mounted; mount-component is the entry that creates the component.

gloss: Register a named component, view mode or handler so page markup or other code can find it by name or id.
test: Stores an entry under a name at startup, or looks up a registered entry by its id.
not: publish-page-api: that exposes functions as page globals; register-component keeps a lookup table inside the library.

gloss: Expose functions, helpers or a component on the page's global object for markup or other scripts.
test: Assigns functions or constructors to window or the page scope so they can be called from outside the module.
not: register-component: that keeps a named lookup for components; publish-page-api assigns to the global scope.

gloss: Load a script, stylesheet, library or component the first time it is needed, and skip it afterward.
test: Inserts a script or stylesheet tag or imports a module on demand, remembers it, and does not load it twice.
not: load-data-once: that fetches a data source and caches the parsed data; load-asset-once loads code or styling.

gloss: Fetch a data file once, cache the parsed result, and reuse it on later calls.
test: Reads a JSON or text data source on first use and returns the cached value afterward.
not: load-asset-once: that loads code, styles or components; load-data-once returns parsed data.

gloss: Run work in a later animation frame, or limit a repeated event to one run per frame.
test: Defers a function with requestAnimationFrame, or coalesces many scroll or resize events into one update per frame.
not: debounce-input: that waits for a pause in input; schedule-next-frame runs at the next paint regardless of pauses.

gloss: Wait for typing or input to pause before acting on it.
test: Resets a timer on each input event and runs the action only after a quiet interval.
not: schedule-next-frame: that runs at the next paint; debounce-input waits for a quiet period.

gloss: Set an element's visual state (active, idle, busy, error, sign colour) from a value.
test: Adds, removes or swaps a class, colour or icon so the element shows its current state.
not: show-hide-element: that changes whether an element is shown at all; state-styling changes how a shown element looks.

gloss: Show or hide a region, pane, panel or control.
test: Toggles the visibility or open state of one element or region, or of a pane that a user opens and closes.
not: state-styling: that restyles an element that stays visible; show-hide-element removes it from view or reveals it.

gloss: Draw one labelled section, pane or strip of a component's markup.
test: Builds the markup for a named part of a component (a header, a pane, a toolbar, a list-and-detail split) and places it in the layout.
not: render-current-view: that redraws the body for the view currently chosen; draw-panel-section lays out a fixed part of the component.

gloss: Redraw the body of a component for the view or file currently chosen.
test: Reads the current view or file selection and rebuilds the displayed body, falling back to a default view when the choice is missing.
not: switch-view: that changes which view is chosen; render-current-view redraws whatever is chosen.

gloss: Show one named view, tab or panel among several, and mark its tab as current.
test: Changes the chosen view or tab and updates which panel is visible and which tab button is highlighted.
not: render-current-view: that redraws the body after a choice; switch-view changes the choice itself.

gloss: Read or write the page address so the selected item or tab survives a reload or can be linked.
test: Rewrites the URL hash or query to show the current selection, or reads the address at start to select an item.
not: select-item-in-list: that holds the selection in memory; address-state mirrors it into the address.

gloss: Open a menu of actions for a target, run the action the reader picks, and close the menu.
test: Shows a list of named actions beside a target, runs the chosen one, shows any result briefly, and closes.
not: action-button: that is one button that runs one handler; action-menu offers several actions from one trigger.

gloss: Position a floating panel or menu beside an anchor and keep it inside the window.
test: Computes a panel's position from an anchor element and clamps it to the viewport edges.
not: action-menu: that decides what the menu offers and runs actions; place-floating-panel only positions it.

gloss: Close a floating panel or menu when the reader taps or clicks outside it, or scrolls.
test: Listens for an outside press or scroll once the panel is open, closes the panel, and stops listening.
not: close-fullscreen-deck: that closes a full-screen viewer; dismiss-on-outside handles small floating surfaces.

gloss: Build a labelled or icon button that runs a handler when pressed.
test: Creates a button element with a label, icon, or tooltip and attaches a click handler.
not: action-menu: that offers several actions from one trigger; action-button is one button with one handler.

gloss: Build a pill or chip for one choice or value, with an optional count and an active or idle look.
test: Creates a pill for a single-choice option or frequent value, optionally showing a count, and styles it active or idle.
not: action-button: that runs a handler; choice-pill represents a selectable value or choice.

gloss: Build a labelled dropdown whose change redraws part of a component.
test: Creates a select element with a label and calls a redraw when its value changes.
not: choice-pill: that is a row of clickable pills; labelled-select is one dropdown.

gloss: Copy text to the clipboard, including preparing the clipboard helper ahead of use.
test: Writes text to the clipboard through the clipboard API or a fallback, once the helper is ready.
not: download-file: that saves a file; copy-to-clipboard puts text on the clipboard.

gloss: Save text or data to the reader's device as a named file.
test: Creates a blob, points a link at it, and triggers a download with a file name.
not: copy-to-clipboard: that puts the same content on the clipboard instead of a file.

gloss: Show a brief confirmation, such as a flashed button label or a saved note, that clears by itself.
test: Changes a label, icon or short note for a moment after an action, then restores it.
not: status-message: that holds a persistent message about state; confirmation-flash is a brief acknowledgement after an action.

gloss: Show a spinner or busy state while work is in progress.
test: Displays a spinner or disabled busy state from the start of a request or load until it settles.
not: status-message: that states a result or error; busy-indicator shows work in progress.

gloss: Show a short in-place note for an empty, error, capped, stale or not-ready state.
test: Writes a line of text in the component that says why there is no content, that something is cut or failed, or that a run is still needed.
not: explain-failure: that turns a raw failure into plain words and a likely cause; status-message is the line that carries it.

gloss: Turn a component's current state or settings into one short descriptive line.
test: Produces a single human-readable sentence or label summarising counts, settings, sizes, or the outcome of a check.
not: status-message: that flags an empty, error or capped condition; status-line describes the state in general.

gloss: Turn a failed request, load or refusal into plain words, a headline and a likely cause.
test: Takes a status code, error or refusal and returns a headline and a plain explanation of the likely cause.
not: status-message: that shows the note in place; explain-failure decides the words for a failure.

gloss: Format a number for display: thousands separators, decimal places, parentheses for negatives, dashes for missing.
test: Returns display text for a number with grouping, fixed decimals, accounting negatives, or a dash for zero or missing.
not: parse-number-text: that reads text into a number; format-number writes a number as text.

gloss: Measure a value's size in bytes, or format a byte count for display.
test: Computes the byte length of a value, or turns a byte count into a readable size with units.
not: status-line: that describes state in a sentence; byte-size produces a size figure.

gloss: Describe a timestamp as the time elapsed from now.
test: Turns a timestamp into a phrase such as five minutes ago, relative to the current time.
not: format-date-display: that writes a date or time in a fixed format; format-relative-time measures distance from now.

gloss: Format a date or timestamp in a fixed display form, including the owner or age shown beside a stored item.
test: Returns a fixed-format date or time string for a stored date value.
not: format-relative-time: that expresses elapsed time; format-date-display writes the date itself.

gloss: Build a count label that reads correctly for one or many items, or a read-one-at-a-time label.
test: Chooses singular or plural for a noun by count and returns the label text.
not: status-line: that describes a whole state; pluralize-count-label is about the noun and the count only.

gloss: Show long text cut short, with a control to expand it, and link any web address in it.
test: Truncates a text value for display, offers a tap to show more, and turns addresses into links.
not: cell-display-text: that prepares a table cell's content; clamp-long-text handles text in rows and lines.

gloss: Keep an index or position inside its valid range.
test: Returns the nearest valid index when a value falls below zero or past the last item.
not: scroll-position-index: that derives an index from a scroll position; clamp-index only bounds a number.

gloss: Scroll a strip, list or view so that a given item or row is in view.
test: Moves the scroll position to bring a named item, card, row or slide into view, possibly after layout.
not: scroll-position-index: that reads the current item from the scroll position; scroll-to-target sets the position.

gloss: Read which item is current from a strip's scroll position.
test: Finds the item nearest the edge or centre of a scrolling strip and updates the current index from scroll events.
not: scroll-to-target: that moves the scroll to an item; scroll-position-index reads the position back.

gloss: Hold a selected item in a list, strip or tree, keep it valid after changes, and show its detail.
test: Records which item is selected, updates highlights and detail when it changes, and reselects when the selection disappears.
not: address-state: that mirrors the selection into the page address; select-item-in-list holds it inside the component.

gloss: Step a selection or slide with the arrow keys, ignoring keys typed into form fields.
test: Listens for arrow key presses, moves the current item one step, and skips keys pressed inside inputs.
not: select-item-in-list: that holds the selection; arrow-key-step is the keyboard route that moves it.

gloss: Keep the rows, entries or tree nodes that match a search term or a chosen value, and mark the matches.
test: Filters a list, grid or tree down to matching items and marks which entries match.
not: order-items: that changes the order without removing anything; search-filter removes non-matching items.

gloss: Order items by a key: an aggregate, source position, priority, or a stated sequence.
test: Sorts a list, siblings or children by a chosen key, largest first or in source order.
not: search-filter: that removes items; order-items keeps all of them in a new sequence.

gloss: Draw nested rows with expand and collapse, under a row budget.
test: Builds rows for a tree, opens or closes groups on tap, and stops adding rows once a cap is reached.
not: flatten-tree-rows: that turns a tree into fixed table rows for output; tree-rows is an interactive view.

gloss: Limit how many rows or characters are shown or kept, and say when the limit cut the list.
test: Stops at a row or size budget, counts the items cut, and marks the view as capped.
not: status-message: that writes the note; row-cap is the limit itself.

gloss: Render a value as indented JSON text.
test: Serialises a value with indentation for display or export, optionally capped.
not: delimited-text-write: that writes rows as CSV or TSV; pretty-print-json writes nested data as JSON.

gloss: Return a handle or object that lets the caller control a component after it is built.
test: Returns a set of functions or an object that the caller uses to drive the component later, such as an unregister function.
not: publish-page-api: that exposes names on the global object; return-control-handle gives one caller a handle.

gloss: Remove a component from the page and release its listeners and state.
test: Removes a view's elements and detaches global listeners when the component is closed or replaced.
not: close-fullscreen-deck: that closes an overlay viewer; teardown-component removes any component's page presence.

gloss: Insert a block of CSS into the page once, and reserve the layout space it needs.
test: Adds a style element with its rules only if it is not already present.
not: load-asset-once: that loads a stylesheet file; inject-style-once writes rules inline.

gloss: Split a long line for display, breaking only after separators.
test: Breaks a text line at separator characters so each piece stays readable in a narrow space.
not: clamp-long-text: that shortens text; wrap-text-line keeps all of it and breaks the lines.

gloss: Show a secret only as its last few characters.
test: Replaces all but the last few characters of a token or secret with a mask before it is displayed.
not: token-format: that names the kind of token from its prefix; mask-secret hides the value.

gloss: Return keyboard focus to the component when a stray element takes it.
test: Detects focus landing on an element outside the component and moves focus back inside.
not: arrow-key-step: that moves a selection; focus-return fixes where focus sits.

gloss: Watch selection, tab or page state and react when it changes.
test: Registers a change watcher on a piece of state and runs a function when its value changes.
not: publish-page-api: that exposes functions; state-watch reacts to changes in state.

gloss: Send a question to a linked page and read its answer or refusal.
test: Posts a message to another page or frame, waits for its reply, and returns the data or the refusal.
not: fetch-repo-file: that reads files from a repository; ask-linked-page queries another running page.

gloss: Ask the reader to confirm before removing or clearing something.
test: Shows a confirmation step before a delete or clear runs, and runs it only on confirm.
not: action-menu: that offers actions; confirm-destructive-action gates one irreversible action.

gloss: Build the trail of buttons showing the current path, dimming the crumbs that are not current.
test: Renders a row of path segments as buttons, with the current one marked.
not: tree-rows: that draws nested rows; breadcrumb-trail draws one line of path crumbs.

gloss: Move the focus of nested data to a new path, resetting the view state that depended on the old focus.
test: Sets the focused path, clears open rows and paging, and scrolls the view back to the top.
not: json-path-read: that reads a value at a path; focus-path changes which path is shown.

gloss: Read the value at a path in nested data, and turn a path into a readable label.
test: Walks keys or indexes to return a value, or joins path segments into a display key.
not: focus-path: that changes the focus; json-path-read only reads.

gloss: Build a table from rows or records: headers from keys, one row each, with an error line for bad input and a column signature for later updates.
test: Creates the grid or table element with headers and cells from rows and records the column signature it was built with.
not: update-grid-in-place: that refreshes rows in an existing grid; build-table creates the grid.

gloss: Prepare one field's value as table cell text, showing nested values as JSON and keeping truncated text whole.
test: Turns a field value into cell text, serialising nested values and retaining the full text for a truncated cell.
not: clamp-long-text: that clips text in place for reading; cell-display-text prepares a table cell.

gloss: Profile the shape of a JSON value: node counts, value types, inferred columns, and how full each field is.
test: Counts nodes by type, infers columns from a list of records, and summarises each field's type and fill.
not: profile-columns: that profiles a table of rows; json-shape-profile works on nested JSON.

gloss: List a table's visible data columns.
test: Returns the names of the columns currently shown, excluding hidden or internal ones.
not: hide-blank-columns: that changes which columns are hidden; visible-columns only reports them.

gloss: Attach a per-row handler to a table so each row can be tapped for a menu or an action.
test: Wires a tap or click listener on a table's rows that identifies the tapped row and passes it to a handler.
not: action-menu: that shows the menu; attach-row-action wires the taps that open it.

gloss: Give a record a one-line label, using its first usable field.
test: Picks the first non-empty field value, or a short summary sentence, to label a record in one line.
not: status-line: that describes a component's state; record-label names one record.

gloss: Fetch a file's text from a repository on the code host and show it, or report a failed load.
test: Requests a named file from the repository, returns its text, and reports a load error when the request fails.
not: load-data-once: that caches a data source for reuse; fetch-repo-file reads a named file from a repository on each request.

gloss: Parse a file of one JSON record per line, skipping lines that are not valid JSON.
test: Splits text into lines, parses each as JSON, and drops the lines that fail.
not: csv-parse: that reads comma-separated rows; jsonl-parse reads one JSON value per line.

gloss: List the files in a folder as repository paths from the root.
test: Returns the files directly in the shown folder, each with its full repository path.
not: fetch-repo-file: that reads a file's content; folder-file-list lists the paths.

gloss: Read a number from text, accepting currency marks, digit grouping and parenthesised negatives.
test: Converts a financial or plain number string to a number, reading brackets as negative and returning nothing for non-numbers.
not: format-number: that writes a number as text; parse-number-text reads text into a number.

gloss: Profile every column of a table: fill share, distinct counts, and decimal places.
test: Walks each column and reports how many cells are filled, how many values are distinct, and the decimal precision.
not: summarize-column: that summarises one column's values in detail; profile-columns covers all columns for an overview.

gloss: Summarise one column's values: value types, samples, distribution and most frequent values.
test: Returns the types seen, sample values, a numeric distribution, or the top values for a single column.
not: profile-columns: that covers every column for an overview; summarize-column details one column.

gloss: Decide what kind of column this is (number, date, text, dimension or measure) from its values.
test: Looks at the values in a column and assigns a kind or role, such as mostly numeric or key-like.
not: classify-kind: that names the category of a single value, format or part; classify-column decides a whole column's role.

gloss: Name the category of one value, number format code or package part.
test: Maps a single cell value, number format code, or part name to a named kind such as date, percent, or chart.
not: classify-column: that decides a whole column's role from many values; classify-kind names one item.

gloss: Hide or show columns that are entirely empty.
test: Finds columns with no filled cells and toggles their visibility.
not: visible-columns: that lists which columns are shown; hide-blank-columns changes which are shown.

gloss: Draw one chart mark, such as a histogram bar, with a tooltip.
test: Creates the element for one bar or mark sized to its value, with a hover or tap label.
not: read-chart-model: that reads a chart definition from a file; draw-chart-mark draws one mark on the page.

gloss: Group rows by chosen fields into a tree of row and column keys, adding empty cells and totals.
test: Assigns each record to a path of group keys, creates the cells for each path, and places each value into its cell.
not: flatten-tree-rows: that turns the finished tree into table rows; pivot-tree-build creates the tree.

gloss: Fold values into a total with a chosen function (sum, count, average), including running, subtotal and grand totals.
test: Adds each value into a running total or cell and returns the aggregate, zero when there are no values.
not: order-items: that sorts totals; aggregate-total computes them.

gloss: Turn a tree of groups into flat table rows, filling group labels from the path.
test: Visits each node in order and emits one row per node or per detail record, with its group labels.
not: tree-rows: that is an interactive expandable view; flatten-tree-rows produces static rows.

gloss: Shade a table cell on a colour scale, or draw an inline value bar.
test: Maps a cell's value to a colour between the ends of a scale, or sizes a bar inside the cell.
not: state-styling: that marks a state such as active or error; heat-scale-cell maps a magnitude to a colour.

gloss: Set a pivot's row and column dimensions, measure and aggregate; toggle group-bys; reset to defaults.
test: Changes one pivot setting and enforces the group-by limit where one applies.
not: drag-reorder: that moves an item by dragging; pivot-settings-set changes a setting value.

gloss: Place a dragged item among an ordered list, or remove it from the list.
test: Takes a dragged item and a drop position and inserts or removes it from the ordered list.
not: pivot-settings-set: that sets values; drag-reorder moves items between positions.

gloss: Build a report model from rows or a pivot tree, with band columns, subtotal and total rows, and sibling order.
test: Produces a report structure whose columns are bands and whose rows carry subtotals and totals.
not: report-html-draw: that draws the model as a table; report-model-build defines its structure.

gloss: Draw a report model as an HTML table, or draw one of its rows.
test: Creates table rows and cells from a report model, one row at a time.
not: report-model-build: that defines the structure; report-html-draw renders it.

gloss: Show a row label only when it differs from the row above it.
test: Compares each label with the previous one and blanks repeats down a column.
not: report-html-draw: that draws the whole table; suppress-repeated-label decides one cell's label.

gloss: Write rows as CSV or tab-separated text, in column order, quoting only where needed.
test: Serialises rows to delimited text with the given columns, quoting cells that contain separators.
not: pretty-print-json: that writes JSON; delimited-text-write writes table text.

gloss: Split CSV text or a CSV line into fields, respecting quotes, and read it into keyed records.
test: Parses comma-separated text, keeping commas inside quotes, and maps rows to header keys.
not: parse-text-data: that accepts JSON, CSV or plain text; csv-parse handles only CSV.

gloss: Parse pasted or dropped text as JSON, CSV or plain lines into rows, dropping empty rows.
test: Tries JSON, then CSV, falls back to lines, and returns rows with empty ones removed.
not: csv-parse: that only reads CSV; parse-text-data chooses among formats.

gloss: Join list values into one semicolon-separated cell, or split such a cell back into a list.
test: Converts between an array and one semicolon-delimited string, keeping blank lists as null where stated.
not: registry-table-io: that reads or writes a whole table; list-cell-codec handles one list-valued cell.

gloss: Read or write a registry CSV table with its fixed column order and list cells.
test: Loads or saves a registry table, applying the column order and list conversions for its rows.
not: csv-parse: that is generic CSV reading; registry-table-io applies the registry's own column and list rules.

gloss: Gzip text to base64 and back, for compressing parts of a bundle or a pasted payload.
test: Compresses a string to base64 or decompresses base64 back to text.
not: compose-bundle: that assembles parts into one bundle; gzip-text-codec converts one string.

gloss: Assemble selected compressed parts into one bundle text, with metadata for non-default layouts.
test: Gathers the chosen parts, adds metadata entries where the layout is not the default, and stores the bundle text and its size.
not: bundle-selection: that chooses which keys go in; compose-bundle assembles the text.

gloss: List the bundle keys in order with their selection and size, and flip a key's selection.
test: Lists every possible bundle key with whether it is included and its size, and toggles one key.
not: compose-bundle: that builds the bundle text from the selection.

gloss: Restore a workbench or tab from bundle text, including its stored outputs.
test: Parses bundle text and rebuilds tabs and outputs from its entries.
not: restore-local-state: that restores from browser storage; bundle-restore restores from a bundle.

gloss: Choose the download or copy payload and its format from the view on screen, returning the text.
test: Decides whether a copy or download gets the bundle, a table, or JSON, based on the visible view.
not: compose-bundle: that builds the bundle; export-payload picks what leaves the page.

gloss: Send active rows, a preview, a pivot or other content to the output viewer.
test: Hands a result to the viewer component and clears any preview that was showing.
not: switch-view: that changes which view is chosen inside the viewer; send-to-viewer supplies its content.

gloss: Accept rows and recipe tabs from the host page at start, and apply them to the initial editor state.
test: Takes data and recipe requests passed in by the embedding page and applies them when the component loads.
not: build-initial-state: that builds defaults; host-handoff takes the host's input.

gloss: Tell the embedding page about a change, or hand it a header to show.
test: Calls a callback or dispatches an event on the host with new state or a header to show.
not: publish-page-api: that exposes functions to the page; notify-host reports a change outward.

gloss: Save a tab or pivot as a recipe the host page can reuse, named from its columns.
test: Creates a recipe entry from the current tab or pivot settings and gives it a name.
not: save-local-state: that persists state in the browser; host-recipe-save hands a recipe to the host.

gloss: Produce standalone source text for a tab, pivot or worker, with the current settings embedded as literals.
test: Writes a runnable snippet or function body with the current settings baked in.
not: pretty-print-json: that serialises data; generate-source-text writes code.

gloss: Hold built-in sample records so a page can demonstrate itself without real data.
test: Declares a fixed set of example records in the page for display when no real data is loaded.
not: load-data-once: that fetches and caches a real data source; sample-data-hold keeps fixed example records in the page.

gloss: Add fields computed from each record, such as a variance or a status.
test: Computes new values for each record from its existing fields and attaches them to the record.
not: classify-column: that decides a column's kind from many values; derive-record-fields adds per-record values.

gloss: Run a payload in a background worker, passing progress and results back, and end the worker when done.
test: Starts a worker from source text, posts the payload, forwards messages, and terminates the worker on completion.
not: run-transform-chain: that decides what runs and in what order; run-in-worker is the mechanism that runs it off the page thread.

gloss: Run chained transform tabs in dependency order, passing identity tabs through and posting each result.
test: Orders tabs by their references, waits for inputs, runs each one, and posts its result or error.
not: run-in-worker: that is the background mechanism; run-transform-chain decides the order and the results.

gloss: Mark tabs stale when their inputs change, along with every tab that reads them.
test: Flags a changed tab and every tab that depends on it as waiting for a run.
not: run-transform-chain: that runs tabs; invalidate-dependents only marks them stale.

gloss: Stack input batches into one combined list.
test: Concatenates the rows of the selected input batches into one input.
not: input-batch-manage: that adds, renames or switches batches; combine-batches merges their rows.

gloss: Add, switch or drop input batches, marking each as input or reference.
test: Changes a batch's role or adds one to the list, then refreshes the combined input.
not: combine-batches: that joins rows; input-batch-manage manages the batch list.

gloss: Finish an in-place rename of a tab or batch, and run again if the name matters.
test: Accepts the new name on blur or enter, saves it, and marks dependent work for a rerun.
not: unique-name: that finds a name not in use; commit-rename applies the name the reader chose.

gloss: Add a tab from a recipe or as a blank, or focus an existing tab that already uses the name.
test: Creates a new tab entry in the tab list from a recipe or a blank template, or moves focus to a same-named tab.
not: dimension-table-build: that adds a dimension table from a key; add-tab adds a general tab.

gloss: Remove a tab by position, keeping the last tab and any fixed tabs.
test: Deletes one tab from the list unless it is the last one or a fixed one.
not: add-tab: that adds a tab; remove-tab deletes one.

gloss: Make a name that is not already used in a set, from a seed or the next free number.
test: Returns a name absent from a given collection, adding a suffix or number when the seed is taken.
not: commit-rename: that saves a name the reader chose; unique-name invents a free one.

gloss: List the scopes that can be inspected, and switch the one shown while computing any missing outputs.
test: Lists the scope options, sets the active one, and runs any scope that has never been computed.
not: scope-output-to-tabs: that copies an output onto tabs; scope-select changes which scope is inspected.

gloss: Copy the active scope's output onto each tab.
test: Writes the chosen scope's result into every tab's output slot.
not: scope-select: that changes which scope is inspected; scope-output-to-tabs copies its output.

gloss: Hand a referenced tab's output to the tab that reads it, and release the output after its last reader.
test: Looks up the output named by a reference, passes it on, and frees it once no reader needs it.
not: scan-tab-references: that finds what a tab refers to; resolve-tab-reference supplies the value.

gloss: Find the tab or input names a transform's source refers to, and describe them.
test: Scans source text for dollar-prefixed names, checks which resolve, and reports any that do not.
not: resolve-tab-reference: that supplies the output; scan-tab-references finds the names.

gloss: Check whether a key determines its columns, and count the keys that split on each column.
test: Groups rows by a key and counts how many keys carry more than one value in an attribute column.
not: key-candidate-scan: that proposes candidate keys; key-split-check tests a chosen key.

gloss: Propose candidate keys from the columns and mark key and attribute columns.
test: Enumerates candidate column sets, lists them, and marks which columns are key or attribute.
not: key-split-check: that tests whether a key determines its columns; key-candidate-scan proposes them.

gloss: Save a picked set of columns as a named custom key, or remove one, then rescan the candidates.
test: Adds or deletes a user-defined key entry and triggers a rescan.
not: key-candidate-scan: that proposes keys from the data; custom-key-manage stores the reader's own key.

gloss: Group rows by the picked key and build a grouped report and a dimension preview.
test: Partitions rows by key values and produces grouped output and a preview for the viewer.
not: pivot-tree-build: that groups for a pivot with measures; group-rows-by-key partitions by a key for a dimension.

gloss: Build a dimension table with one row per key combination, and add it as a tab.
test: Produces one row for each key value, flags rows that come from a split key, and adds the result as a tab.
not: fact-table-build: that keeps the rows without the dimension attributes; dimension-table-build creates the dimension.

gloss: Build the fact table that drops dimension attributes, reusing a generated fact tab if one exists.
test: Removes dimension attribute columns from the source and returns the remaining fact rows.
not: dimension-table-build: that makes the dimension rows; fact-table-build keeps what remains.

gloss: Nest key candidates by what they express, into a tree.
test: Groups candidates into parent and child nodes based on the columns each one determines.
not: flatten-tree-rows: that turns a tree into a display list; candidate-tree-build creates the tree.

gloss: Convert rows to column form and back.
test: Transposes a list of row objects into per-column arrays, and reverses the transform.
not: parse-text-data: that reads text into rows; row-column-convert reshapes data already read.

gloss: Show one file in a chosen view, holding the file's data and switching views as needed.
test: Stores the current file and its data, shows it in the selected view, and falls back to the first view.
not: render-current-view: that redraws the body; file-viewer owns the file and its view choice.

gloss: Refresh a table's rows in place, and decline the update when the columns have changed.
test: Replaces rows in an existing grid without rebuilding it, and returns false when the column signature differs.
not: build-table: that builds a new grid; update-grid-in-place changes rows in one that exists.

gloss: Build a component's starting state from defaults, host input and any saved state.
test: Assembles the initial values and tabs a component starts with, such as an identity tab or an empty workbench.
not: restore-local-state: that reads saved browser state; build-initial-state assembles the starting point from all sources.

gloss: Save named state to browser local storage, skipping the save when persistence is off.
test: Writes a key with serialised state, removes it when the value is blank, and does nothing when persistence is disabled.
not: restore-local-state: that reads it back; save-local-state writes it.

gloss: Read saved state back from browser local storage, moving a value from an older key if needed.
test: Reads and parses stored state, migrating from a previous key when one is present.
not: storage-read-safe: that reads one raw value without throwing; restore-local-state rebuilds a component's state from it.

gloss: Read a stored value without ever throwing, returning a fallback when storage is blocked.
test: Wraps a storage read in a guard and returns empty or a default value on failure.
not: restore-local-state: that rebuilds state; storage-read-safe reads one raw value safely.

gloss: List the stored local keys and database stores with their owners, sizes or record counts, and summarise them.
test: Enumerates local storage keys and databases, reports each with its size, owner or record count, and gives a total.
not: db-store-read: that reads the rows of one store; storage-inventory lists all of them.

gloss: Read the rows of one database store and return them as data.
test: Opens one object store and returns its records, optionally as JSON.
not: storage-inventory: that lists stores and their sizes; db-store-read returns one store's rows.

gloss: Give a stored item its file name and text for display.
test: Returns the item's name and readable text, or its pretty-printed value.
not: db-store-read: that reads the rows; storage-item-text names one item for display.

gloss: Check a saved GitHub token with the code host, and record its quota, scopes and the account that accepted it.
test: Calls the account endpoint with the token and returns the account, scopes and remaining request count.
not: token-format: that inspects the token string without calling GitHub; token-check asks GitHub whether it works.

gloss: Tell what kind of GitHub token a string is from its prefix, and check its shape before saving.
test: Reads the prefix and length of a typed token and names its format, without any network call.
not: token-check: that calls GitHub to see whether the token is accepted.

gloss: Save a valid token and reload, or clear the saved token after confirmation and reload.
test: Writes or removes the stored token and reloads the page so the change takes effect.
not: confirm-destructive-action: that asks the question; token-save-clear performs the change.

gloss: Read a pull request's state and its check results from the code host.
test: Requests the pull request and its checks and returns the state and a check summary.
not: fetch-repo-file: that reads file content; pr-state-read reads pull request status.

gloss: Turn a typed link or pull request reference into its parts and a display target.
test: Parses a URL or an owner/repo#number reference into owner, repo, number, path or branch, and returns what to show.
not: link-build: that writes a link out; link-target-resolve reads one in.

gloss: Build a link to a review page or other destination for an item, or an empty link where none applies.
test: Produces a URL for an item's review page, or an empty value for item kinds that have none.
not: link-target-resolve: that parses a link it is given; link-build makes one.

gloss: Post a chosen answer to a repository file or a pull request comment, requiring a note where needed, and record it locally.
test: Writes an answer line to the repository or comments on a pull request, adds it to the local list, and resets the form on success.
not: answer-choices: that lists the options; post-answer sends the one chosen.

gloss: List the answer options for a question, with the recommended one first and a message-only choice where a merge needs it.
test: Returns the ordered list of answers for a question with the recommended one first.
not: post-answer: that sends an answer; answer-choices lists them.

gloss: Route a click or tap inside a component to the action its element names, stopping it reaching parent elements.
test: Reads the clicked element's action key and calls the matching handler, stopping propagation where needed.
not: action-button: that creates a button; click-dispatch routes clicks that already happen.

gloss: Mark glossary terms in text so a click pins their note, and list the terms a card mentions.
test: Wraps matching terms in focusable markup and shows or pins the note when one is activated.
not: clamp-long-text: that shortens text; glossary-term-mark turns terms into links to notes.

gloss: Render a decision tree with its lines, child decisions and links.
test: Builds the nested markup for a decision tree from its data.
not: render-current-view: that redraws a chosen view; decision-tree-render builds one structure.

gloss: List a call's materials with their shipped proofs.
test: Returns the materials for a call and attaches any proof that has shipped.
not: order-items: that sorts items; materials-list collects them.

gloss: Embed an HTML material in a sandboxed frame, loading its stored markup when it is missing.
test: Creates a sandboxed iframe holding the given markup, loading the markup first if it is absent.
not: render-file-html: that turns a file into HTML; embed-sandboxed-html places HTML in an isolated frame.

gloss: Fetch a file and render it as HTML for display.
test: Gets a file's content and converts it into displayable HTML.
not: fetch-repo-file: that only gets the text; render-file-html converts it for display.

gloss: Get or create a cached preview record for a file.
test: Returns an existing preview record for a file or creates an empty one.
not: load-data-once: that caches one data source; preview-cache holds per-file preview records.

gloss: Open a set of slides, cards or items as a full-screen viewer, nested above any viewer already open.
test: Creates the overlay, sets the starting slide, and pushes the viewer onto the viewer stack.
not: close-fullscreen-deck: that closes a viewer; open-fullscreen-deck opens one.

gloss: Close a full-screen viewer once, together with any viewers above it, releasing slides and restoring page scroll.
test: Removes the overlay from the stack, releases its slides, restores page scroll, animates out, and runs its callbacks.
not: history-back-close: that decides when Back closes a viewer; close-fullscreen-deck performs the close.

gloss: Make the browser Back button close the top viewer layer, ignoring history changes the viewer caused itself.
test: Pushes a history entry on open, closes the top layer on a history pop, and flags pops that it caused.
not: close-fullscreen-deck: that performs the close; history-back-close connects Back to it.

gloss: Animate a panel in or out, such as sliding a nested viewer in from the right.
test: Applies a transition to a panel's position and clears the transition styles afterward.
not: show-hide-element: that toggles visibility without motion; animate-panel moves a panel with a transition.

gloss: Build a horizontal track of slides, slots or file panels, one per item, that render on demand.
test: Creates the track and one slot per item, moves to a given slot, and reports which one is showing.
not: lazy-slide-fill: that fills one slide's content; lazy-slide-track builds the track that holds the slides.

gloss: Render a slide's content the first time it nears the reader, and empty it when the reader moves away.
test: Fills a slide with its content when it is nearby, and releases it, running any release hook, once it is far away.
not: lazy-slide-track: that builds the track; lazy-slide-fill fills and releases its slides.

gloss: Draw slide pager dots or a bar, previous and next controls, and the slide number.
test: Creates pager markup, highlights the current slide, and hides the arrows at either end.
not: slide-index-change: that tells listeners the slide moved; slide-pager shows the position.

gloss: Track the current slide and notify listeners when it changes.
test: Records the current index, updates it once a swipe settles, and calls callbacks when it changes.
not: slide-pager: that draws the position; slide-index-change reports it to listeners.

gloss: Build or update a viewer's header: title, link, icon or logo, and action buttons.
test: Creates the header row with its title, optional link, and action buttons, and updates them when the file or branch changes.
not: build-viewer-frame: that builds the overlay around the header; viewer-header-bar builds the header only.

gloss: Assemble an overlay or panel shell with its close control, header and footer slots, and a control handle.
test: Creates the overlay container, the panel, the close button and the handle the caller uses.
not: viewer-header-bar: that builds the header that sits inside the shell.

gloss: Hide the header and footer while reading down, and show them again on upward scroll or a body tap.
test: Toggles header and footer visibility from scroll direction or taps, skipping the change when nothing differs.
not: show-hide-element: that toggles on command; chrome-auto-hide decides from scroll or taps.

gloss: Open a contents list of slides, label its rows, mark the current one, and go to a slide when its row is tapped.
test: Builds a list with one row per slide, adds section headings, and moves to the chosen slide.
not: search-filter: that filters content by a term; table-of-contents lists slides for navigation.

gloss: Attach a drag handle that resizes a docked pane, and keep it in step with the pane's measurements.
test: Adds or removes a handle when docking changes and updates its position when the pane is resized.
not: drag-reorder: that reorders a list by dragging; drag-resize-handle resizes a pane.

gloss: Decide whether a viewer may dock beside the page, show the dock toggle, and switch between docked and full-pane.
test: Applies the host's docking condition, shows the toggle only when docking is allowed, and toggles the docked state.
not: page-scroll-lock: that stops the page scrolling; dock-pane-mode decides whether the viewer docks.

gloss: Lock the page's scroll while an overlay is open, unless the viewer is docked, and restore it on close.
test: Sets a class or style that stops page scrolling and removes it when the overlay closes.
not: dock-pane-mode: that decides docking; page-scroll-lock stops the page scrolling.

gloss: Define a group of helper functions or constant lookup tables that a reader needs.
test: Declares helpers or constant maps (format codes, palettes, colour tables, type codes, card icons) at module level for later use.
not: publish-page-api: that exposes names on the page; define-helpers only declares them.

gloss: Resolve a colour spec (theme, indexed, RGB, tint, chart automatic) to a hex colour.
test: Takes a colour reference or element and returns a hex value, applying the theme and any tint or shade.
not: colour-convert: that changes between colour representations or does arithmetic; colour-resolve decides which colour a spec means.

gloss: Convert between colour representations (ARGB to hex, RGB to HSL and back) and shift a colour by a tint.
test: Performs the arithmetic conversion between colour formats, or a tint shift, on one colour.
not: colour-resolve: that decides what colour a spec refers to; colour-convert changes its notation.

gloss: Read a font, fill, or border style record from its XML element.
test: Parses a style element for its attributes, colour, and on or off flags such as bold.
not: resolve-cell-style: that decides the visible style for a cell; read-style-element reads one style record.

gloss: Decide a cell's visible style from its format, fill, border and any conditional rule, and look up its number format.
test: Combines inherited style records and the cell's own format into the style it displays.
not: read-style-element: that reads one record; resolve-cell-style combines records for one cell.

gloss: Describe a visual style in plain words, such as what a conditional format paints.
test: Returns a sentence naming the colour, weight, or fill a style applies.
not: status-line: that describes a component's state; describe-style-text describes a style.

gloss: Read a chart part into a chart model: series, axes, titles, cached values and colours.
test: Produces a model with its series, axis settings, title text and cached data from the chart XML.
not: draw-chart-mark: that draws one mark; read-chart-model reads a chart definition.

gloss: Join the text runs of a rich string into one text.
test: Concatenates the text pieces of a rich text element in order.
not: read-sheet-cells: that reads cell values; join-text-runs joins one rich string's pieces.

gloss: Parse one package part as XML, walk its element tree, and count or record each element.
test: Reads a part's XML into a tree, visits its elements, and collects their attributes and text.
not: track-part-connections: that records which parts are connected; parse-package-part reads a part's contents.

gloss: Record how each package part is reached through relationships and sheets, and list the parts nothing reaches.
test: Marks parts as connected, records which sheet or relationship reaches them, and lists those no connection reaches.
not: part-inventory: that tabulates parts and their state; track-part-connections computes that state.

gloss: Tabulate package parts or XML paths with their connection state.
test: Produces a table of parts or paths, each with its connected or unconnected status.
not: track-part-connections: that computes connections; part-inventory presents them.

gloss: Resolve a relative reference inside a package to its full package path.
test: Combines a base part path with a relative reference, handling up-level segments.
not: join-related-parts: that matches parts to sheets or caches; resolve-package-path computes a path.

gloss: Join a sheet, table, pivot or cache to the name, position or record set it belongs to, by relationship id.
test: Matches related parts by id or name and attaches the matching sheet, cache or sheet name.
not: resolve-package-path: that computes a path; join-related-parts links objects to each other.

gloss: Read every part of a workbook package and assemble the workbook result: sheets, names, visibility, comments, pivots and links.
test: Opens the zip, reads each part, and returns a workbook record with its sheets and related content.
not: join-related-parts: that links two objects; read-workbook-package drives the whole read.

gloss: Read a sheet's cells as values, row objects or formulas, resolving shared strings.
test: Parses cell elements into values, formulas and row objects, looking up shared strings where needed.
not: read-sheet-rules: that reads conditional and validation rules; read-sheet-cells reads the cell values.

gloss: Read a sheet's conditional formatting and data validation rules from its XML.
test: Parses the conditional format and data validation elements into rule records with their formulas.
not: read-sheet-cells: that reads cells; read-sheet-rules reads rules.

gloss: Convert column widths and row heights to pixels, and find a column's display width.
test: Turns spreadsheet width or height units into pixel sizes for layout.
not: sheet-layout: that places cells on a grid; sheet-geometry supplies the sizes.

gloss: Collect, shape and clean cell comments and notes, including removing author prefixes.
test: Gathers the comments on a sheet or in the workbook, attaches authors, and returns clean note text.
not: list-sheet-features: that tabulates features as rows; cell-notes gathers the note text.

gloss: Read a table or pivot table definition: its columns, layout and measure names.
test: Parses the table or pivot table XML into column names, ranges and measures.
not: pivot-cache-read: that reads the cache records; read-table-defs reads the table or pivot definition.

gloss: Read a pivot cache's source, field names, shared values and records, resolving each cell to a value.
test: Returns the cache's rows and field values, mapping index cells to their shared values.
not: read-table-defs: that reads the table or pivot layout; pivot-cache-read reads the cache records.

gloss: Read one corner of a drawing anchor as a cell position.
test: Parses a from or to anchor element into a column, row and offset.
not: place-drawings-on-grid: that places drawings on the grid; read-drawing-anchor reads one corner.

gloss: Attach chart or picture data to its drawing.
test: Links a parsed chart or image to the drawing element that holds it.
not: place-drawings-on-grid: that positions the drawing; attach-drawing-content links the content to it.

gloss: Collect a sheet's pictures and charts and place them over the cell grid.
test: Positions each drawing's rectangle against the sheet's grid coordinates.
not: sheet-layout: that lays out the cells; place-drawings-on-grid positions the drawings.

gloss: Encode one picture as a data URI.
test: Turns image bytes into a data: address for display.
not: attach-drawing-content: that links content to a drawing; picture-data-uri encodes the image.

gloss: Convert a spreadsheet date serial to a date, and note whether a workbook uses the 1904 date system.
test: Maps a serial day number to a calendar date under the workbook's epoch.
not: date-format-render: that draws a date through a format code; excel-date-serial converts the number.

gloss: Draw a number through a number format code, choosing the section for its sign, and format a cell value for display.
test: Renders a value with separators, decimals, sign sections or literal text according to a format code.
not: date-format-render: that renders date tokens; number-format-render handles numeric sections.

gloss: Draw a date through a format code, finding and drawing each date token.
test: Walks a date format's tokens and writes its year, month, day or time parts.
not: number-format-render: that handles numeric formats; date-format-render handles date tokens.

gloss: Lay out a sheet's cells, geometry and drawings into a drawn grid for display.
test: Builds the display grid of cells with their sizes and positions for one sheet.
not: display-rows: that builds row records for data; sheet-layout builds the drawn grid.

gloss: Turn parsed sheet rows into display row records.
test: Builds one display record per row with each cell's display value.
not: sheet-layout: that places cells on a grid; display-rows produces records.

gloss: Work out where a cell's text spills into empty neighbours, and whether a cell can take spilled text.
test: Checks neighbouring cells for emptiness and marks the cells whose text runs into them.
not: sheet-layout: that lays out the grid; text-spill decides overflow.

gloss: Read a constant number or string from a formula.
test: Extracts a literal value from formula text when the formula is only a constant.
not: formula-text-give: that returns the formula text; formula-constant-read extracts a literal.

gloss: Give a cell's formula text.
test: Returns the formula string attached to a cell, expanding it if needed.
not: shift-formula-refs: that moves references; formula-text-give returns the text as it is.

gloss: Move cell references in formula text by an offset, outside quoted text, to rebuild shared formulas.
test: Adjusts column letters and row numbers in a formula by the cell's offset, leaving quoted text alone.
not: cell-address-convert: that converts address notation; shift-formula-refs rewrites references inside formulas.

gloss: Convert between column numbers, column letters, cell addresses and cell ranges.
test: Turns A1-style addresses, letters and numbers, or range text, into positions and back.
not: shift-formula-refs: that moves references in a formula; cell-address-convert changes their notation.

gloss: Find the last used column or row, and count hidden columns up to it.
test: Scans cells for the last filled column and counts the hidden columns before it.
not: sheet-layout: that lays out the grid; used-extent reports how far the data reaches.

gloss: List every formula cell with its value, and count the shared-formula followers.
test: Returns each formula cell with its value and counts the cells that share a formula.
not: formula-text-give: that gives one cell's text; list-formula-cells lists them all.

gloss: List one kind of sheet feature (merged ranges, comments, validation rules, conditional formats) as a table.
test: Produces rows for each merged range, comment, rule or format on a sheet.
not: item-to-row: that describes one item; list-sheet-features collects the items for a sheet.

gloss: Describe one item (sheet, connection, pivot, part, rule, range) as a single table row.
test: Returns a flat record with the fields a summary table shows for one item.
not: summary-table: that builds the whole table; item-to-row makes one row.

gloss: Build a summary table from a list of items, one row each.
test: Collects item rows into a table with headers, for a workbook's sheets, connections, pivots or parts.
not: item-to-row: that makes one row; summary-table assembles many.

gloss: Mark cells that carry a feature: a hyperlink, a table role, or a pivot role.
test: Tags each cell with a role or flag based on hyperlinks, table columns or pivot areas.
not: conditional-format-eval: that decides whether a rule applies; mark-cells-by-feature tags cells with features.

gloss: Decide whether a conditional format rule applies to a cell, apply the rules, and report any that cannot be decided.
test: Evaluates a rule's condition for a cell and records the rules it cannot decide.
not: describe-style-text: that describes the style; conditional-format-eval decides whether it applies.

gloss: Resolve the options of a data validation choice list, following list formulas that point at ranges.
test: Returns the option values for a validation list, following a range reference if the list is one.
not: read-sheet-rules: that parses the rule; choice-list-options resolves its options.

gloss: Read the scripts of a Power Query, unpacking its package and exporting its source text.
test: Unpacks a query blob, finds its script, and returns the query source.
not: read-workbook-package: that reads the whole workbook; query-script-read reads queries only.

gloss: List the external data connections a workbook declares.
test: Reads the connections part and returns each declared connection with its type.
not: part-inventory: that lists package parts; external-connections lists data connections.

gloss: Flatten a sheet into a list of cells, and record its merged ranges and used area.
test: Produces one entry per cell with its address and value, plus the merge and extent data.
not: read-sheet-cells: that reads cells from the XML; flatten-sheet-cells produces an export list.

gloss: Define the kinds of content an extract can take, index them by id, and list the kinds a sheet holds but the selection left out.
test: Declares extract kinds and their ids, and reports which kinds a sheet has that the selection did not include.
not: content-count: that counts content; extract-kinds defines what can be taken.

gloss: Count the content on each sheet and across the workbook, by kind.
test: Tallies each sheet's items and the workbook total for each content kind.
not: profile-columns: that profiles columns; content-count tallies content kinds.

gloss: List a workbook's sheets and objects for selection, and add pivot tables and caches to the object list.
test: Builds the selectable list of sheets, pivot tables and caches for the extract picker.
not: extract-build: that builds the extract from the selection; extract-selection-list builds the choices.

gloss: Build an extract from a selection, capping each table at a row limit and recording what was picked and what was left.
test: Creates extract items from the chosen objects, cuts rows to the limit, and records what was taken and what was not.
not: extract-selection-list: that lists the choices; extract-build assembles the result.

gloss: Fill in an extract's destination and file name, and turn a sheet name into a file stem.
test: Produces a file-safe stem and a destination string for an extract.
not: unique-name: that makes a name unused within a set; file-name-make builds the file name itself.
